title.purpose: Dock titles, section titles, brand name. The largest size in the system.

caption.purpose: Column heads, captions, hints, subsection titles.

value.purpose: Every number and every input value, tabular, right-aligned.

label-mono.purpose: Count badges, brand badge, timeline axis ticks.

shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: The only floating element: the tooltip.

shadows.name: selected-ring
shadows.purpose: Selected level row (timeline span uses var(--accent)).

motion.name: dim-light
motion.purpose: Viewport: other levels while a level is selected.

motion.name: dim-strong
motion.purpose: Viewport: other levels while isolating or hovering a level.

components.name: Tool Button
components.description: Transparent toolbar action; Play is the outlined variant.
components.html: <button class="ds-tool-button" type="button"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 3.5v7M5 7.5l3 3 3-3M3.5 10.5v2h9v-2"/></svg>Export</button>
components.css: .ds-tool-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; background: none; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool-button:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1d1f23); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-tool-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Viewport bar toggle; pressed takes the blue selection treatment.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Isolate</button><button class="ds-chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Color by level</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; margin-right: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a2d33); border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.45); background: rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.14); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Flag Chip
components.description: Mono checkbox chip for simplify flags.
components.css: .ds-flag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 7px; margin-right: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a2d33); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 11px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-flag input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-flag:hover { color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-flag:has(input:checked) { border-color: rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.45); background: rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.14); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-flag:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Inset track; pressed segment gets a 1px blue underline.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; padding: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a2d33); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--bg, #0e0f11); } .ds-segment { height: 18px; padding: 0 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segment:hover { color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-segment[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--panel-3, #24262b); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--accent, #7aa2ff); } .ds-segment:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Label, slider and mono number box; the box focuses by border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 100px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 280px; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-control { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 64px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-number { width: 100%; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #2a2d33); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--bg, #0e0f11); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); font: 11px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; appearance: textfield; } .ds-number:hover { border-color: #3a3e46; } .ds-number:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #7aa2ff); } .ds-range { width: 100%; height: 14px; margin: 0; background: none; appearance: none; } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 2px; background: var(--line, #2a2d33); } .ds-range::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 10px; height: 10px; margin-top: -4px; border: 0; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--text, #d7d9de); appearance: none; } .ds-range:hover::-webkit-slider-thumb { background: #fff; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Bottom dock tabs with mono count; warnings count turns amber.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; height: 32px; background: var(--panel, #17181b); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #2a2d33); } .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #222429); background: none; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 12px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #d7d9de); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { background: var(--panel-2, #1d1f23); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent, #7aa2ff); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-count { min-width: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--panel-3, #24262b); color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 600 10px/15px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; text-align: center; } .ds-warn .ds-count { background: rgba(230, 180, 80, 0.1); color: #e6b450; }

components.name: Level Row
components.description: Levels event list row: swatch, mono numbers, share bar in the level colour, blue ring when selected.
components.css: .ds-level { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 64px 44px 34px; column-gap: 8px; row-gap: 5px; align-items: center; width: 288px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line-soft, #222429); background: var(--panel, #17181b); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); font: 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-level:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1d1f23); } .ds-level[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.14); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(122, 162, 255, 0.45); } .ds-level:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent, #7aa2ff); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-id { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font: 600 12px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-swatch { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--level); } .ds-num { font-family: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-muted { color: var(--muted, #8b909a); } .ds-bar { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 2px; background: var(--line-soft, #222429); } .ds-bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--level); } .ds-meta { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font: 11px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Timeline Span
components.description: Distance timeline span: level-colour top edge and 13% fill; selected adds a blue ring.
components.css: .ds-track { display: flex; width: 400px; height: 44px; background: var(--bg, #0e0f11); } .ds-span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 1px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--bg, #0e0f11); border-top: 2px solid var(--level); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--level) 13%, #0e0f11); color: var(--text, #d7d9de); font: 11px ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-span span { color: var(--muted, #8b909a); font-size: 10px; } .ds-span:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--level) 22%, #0e0f11); } .ds-span[aria-pressed='true'] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--level) 24%, #0e0f11); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #7aa2ff); }

narrative.overview:
The page reads like a GPU frame debugger: each LOD level is a draw you inspect, listed as an event in a dense docked list beside the viewport, with its triangles, error and switch distance printed as numbers. Panels are docked graphite slabs separated by 1px splitters; nothing floats over the canvas except the error banner and tooltips.

Density is high and deliberate: 12px system UI text, 22px controls, 32px dock headers. Colour carries meaning, not decoration. Blue is the selection, amber is a warning, and the level colours are data markers that tie a list row to its timeline span and to the tinted instances in the viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Docked grid, 1px splitters, no cards, no floating GUI over the canvas.
One blue for selection and focus, one amber for warnings, a separate data palette for levels.
Monospace tabular numerals for every number and every line of code.
One selection, echoed everywhere: list, timeline, inspector, viewport.

rules.name: The Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Blue means "selected or focused", amber means "warning". Neither appears for emphasis, branding of a section, or decoration. A new state that is neither gets a neutral treatment.

rules.name: The Data Palette Rule
rules.body: Level colours are data, never UI. They mark a level (swatch, bar, timeline span, viewport tint) and nothing else, and new entries must stay out of the blue and amber hue families so a level can never read as selected or warned.

rules.name: The Selection Is A Ring Rule
rules.body: Selecting a level never recolours it. The level keeps its own colour; selection is added on top as a blue tint and 1px blue ring (row, timeline span), or a blue underline (tabs, segments).

rules.name: The Mono Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every number (triangles, share, instance count, error, distance, pixel size) and every code identifier is set in the mono stack with tabular numerals, right-aligned in columns. Sans text never carries a measured value.

rules.name: The Flat Ramp Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight (600), colour (text, muted, faint) and the section-title band, not from size. Stay within 10 to 12px.

rules.name: The Docked Rule
rules.body: Everything is docked. Only transient overlays (tooltip, error banner) float, and the 3D canvas is never covered by persistent controls.

dos: Do dock every new panel into the grid and let the 1px `gap` draw the splitter.
Do set every number and code fragment in the mono stack with tabular numerals, right-aligned in columns.
Do keep controls at the 22px control height and buttons at 24px, with 12px dock padding.
Do give every new control a `data-tooltip`.
Do route any new level view through the shared selection: list, timeline, inspector and viewport dimming move together.
Do mark a level only with its `level-N` colour, and show selection on top of it with blue tint and ring.
donts: Don't use blue for anything but selection and focus, or amber for anything but warnings.
Don't add a level colour in the blue or amber hue families.
Don't add cards, drop shadows or floating panels over the canvas; the tooltip is the only shadowed element.
Don't set measured values in the sans face or grow type beyond 12px for hierarchy.
